`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
The library already has a **central focus ring** (`:focus-visible` with `!important` in `globals.css`). That means most `outline-none` hits are not missing rings — they are leftover shadcn classes. The real a11y holes are the ones the primitives do **not** enforce: `type="button"`, 24px hit targets, `prefers-reduced-motion`, and “please remember `aria-label`.”
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

## Maturity verdict: 3 (defined)

A real Radix/shadcn layer exists (live regions, required `ariaLabel` on SmartSelect, skip-link, virtualized chat/search). Accessibility is a **convention**, not a **guarantee** the primitive enforces. Settings still ships a hand-rolled switch. React Compiler is off; almost nothing is memoized.

Report: `/Users/danielpiatkowski/AI-Agent-Workspace/omnipus/wt-release-session/docs/internal/ui-audit-2026-09-17/lane-c-implementation.md`

## Top 3 fixes

1. **Gate motion once in `globals.css`** — honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for every `animate-in` / accordion / toast. One CSS block covers every overlay you already ship.
2. **Make primitives fail-closed** — default `Button` `type="button"`, 24px hit targets on Checkbox/Switch/Slider, `aria-hidden` on decorative icons, labelled `CommandInput`, required `aria-label` on `size="icon"`. Then delete the Settings fork of Switch.
3. **Fix chrome semantics + Settings URL** — `ScreenHeader` must not emit an `h2` before the page `h1`; Settings tabs should be a controlled `?tab=` value. Enable the React Compiler so agent grids stop rerendering as a unit.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Radix already does focus trap, Escape, and ARIA roles. Best-in-class is what you **add on top**: type defaults, hit targets, reduced motion, and “the compound FormField so `aria-invalid` cannot be forgotten.” Those are the three gaps between this 3 and a 4.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
